Method of Attack: Sandbox escape via customizing the call stack of an error to generate CallSite objects outside the sandbox
Bypassing mitigation using a custom implementation of the prepareStackTrace method
Overriding the global Error object to access CallSite objects and execute commands on the host system
Impacted Systems: Node.js environments using vm2 sandbox library
Virtualization software tools relying on vm2
Attack Vector: Exploitation of sandbox escape vulnerability in vm2 JavaScript sandbox library
